summary: Shortest path over a GraphNode network, returning nodes you can feed straight into a patrol.
overview: Searches a hand-placed node graph rather than a grid. The result is a plain list of nodes, and since each is a MonoBehaviour you can feed their transforms straight into WaypointPatrol.SetWaypoints to actually move something along the route.
useCases: Routing an NPC through a building along authored waypoints.
Finding the cheapest path where cost is not distance.

gotchas.title: Dijkstra, not A*, so it explores in all directions
gotchas.body: Correct and simple, with no heuristic to aim it at the goal. On a large graph a grid A* or a flow field will be faster.
